intro.heading: AUTHENTIC SOUTH INDIAN VEGETARIAN SPECIALITIES IN CENTRAL LONDON
intro.paragraph: In Central London Leicester Square, Arya Bhavan has earned its place as a leading Indian vegetarian restaurant in Central London, attracting diners who appreciate the depth and authenticity of real Indian vegetarian cuisine. Guests exploring the city often search for crispy dosa near me, hearty South Indian breakfast near me, or comforting South and North Indian thali’s—all of which feature prominently on our menu. Known widely as a South Indian restaurant vegetarian food lovers rely on, we remain committed to serving only 100% vegetarian dishes. Our kitchen also offers thoughtful vegan restaurant options and carefully prepared Jain and vegan food restaurant selections for those with specific dietary needs. Families and travellers alike praise Arya Bhavan as a welcoming family-friendly Indian vegetarian restaurant Central London, frequently placing us among the top-rated Indian veg restaurants near me and calling us their best dosa restaurant in Central London. For events, our team also provides exceptional 100% pure vegetarian catering services, from live dosa catering to full-service outdoor catering, corporate catering ensuring authentic flavours at every gathering.

visit.heading: Visit Us Today
visit.text: Whether you’re exploring the city or searching for comforting vegetarian food, Arya Bhavan welcomes you with authentic flavours and heartfelt hospitality.
visit.address: 17 Charing Cross Rd, London WC2H 0EP, United Kingdom

why.heading: Why Guests Love Dining With Us
why.description: Located in Central London near Leicester Square, Arya Bhavan brings the soul of South India to the city. Our kitchen follows traditional cooking methods passed down through generations — stone-ground batters, slow-simmered sambar and freshly prepared chutneys made every morning.
